settings.label: Overview
settings.text: A fast-absorbing serum for every skin type. It restores a worn-out barrier with ceramides, calms visible redness with panthenol and leaves skin looking bouncy rather than slick. Gentle enough for the morning and night routine.

settings.label: How to use
settings.text: After cleansing, press two to three drops into damp skin of the face and neck. Wait a minute, then follow with moisturizer and, in daytime, sunscreen.

settings.label: Ingredients
settings.text: Water, glycerin, niacinamide, ceramide NP, panthenol, plant squalane, sodium hyaluronate, allantoin, plant-derived emollients. The full INCI list sits on the pack, and nothing from our banned list appears in it.

settings.label: Sustainable packaging
settings.text: Glass bottle with an aluminum pump. Rinse it, take the pump off and drop both in a boutique bin or send them back with a prepaid label. Each returned item earns 10 points.

settings.label: About the brand

settings.heading: What each one is there to do

settings.title: Sodium hyaluronate
settings.text: Binds water to the surface so skin looks plumper within minutes.

settings.title: Plant squalane
settings.text: A light oil that softens without leaving a film.

settings.title: Ceramide NP
settings.text: Refills the fatty layer between skin cells that keeps moisture in and irritants out.

settings.title: Panthenol
settings.text: A form of vitamin B5 that takes the edge off tightness and visible redness.

settings.title: Niacinamide
settings.text: Helps dullness and uneven tone fade from view with steady use.

settings.title: Allantoin
settings.text: Smooths rough patches and eases the feel of dry skin.
